title: Turtle of Lost Kittens
description: A large green-eyed sea turtle swims through a surreal landscape, its shell carrying multiple small black kittens. In the sky, a giant bald woman's head with bright green eyes watches as more black kittens and blue water splash from her head. Below is a cracked red road with a 'no cats' sign, colorful coral, orange foxes, and a red sun setting over mountains.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a large detailed sea turtle with bright green eyes swimming through the air, its shell populated by many small black kittens.
